_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the reward screen ($802E-$8229). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Print four zeros after a number (`$802E`)
regions.description: `$18` += 3 (the PPU address moves past the digits just printed) and `JSR $C171` (`$D53F`) with the inline string `04 30 30 30 30`: the four characters `0000`. The scores are in tens of thousands here: a threshold of 3 prints `30000`.

regions.name: Return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): clear the screen
regions.description: `JSR $C01B` (`$D4FD`); `LDA #$20 / JSR $C018` (`$E445`: nametable `$20` cleared).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): clear the attributes
regions.description: `JSR $C06C` (`$D5CC`) with the inline `40 23 C0 00`: 64 bytes of 0 at PPU `$23C0`.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): palette
regions.description: Background palette 0 := `$30` (white), `$21`, `$16` in `$0181-$0183` (the colour the title uses for text).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): title
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` (`$D576`) with the inline string `0C 20 84 'YOU GOT ITEM'`: 12 characters at PPU `$2084`.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): fade in
regions.description: `JSR $C0DE` (`$EDB7`: the fade-in without the switch-on).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the running total
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `06 11 80`: a far call to bank 6 `$8012` (-> `$805A`): the score gained in the corridor is added to the six-digit total `$04B3-$04B8`, and **`$15` := the first three digits as a number, capped at 255** (the points in units of 10,000).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): start of the list
regions.description: `$14` := `$80` (the first icon's tile in pattern table 1), `$19:$18` := `$20C8` (the first item's row).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the next item
regions.description: `LDX $76` (the number of items already given, in steps of 2, kept between corridors). `$76` of `$92` or more (all 73 given) ends the list.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the threshold
regions.description: `$15` (the points) below the threshold `$817A[X]` ends the list: **the table is sorted, so the first one not reached stops it.**

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): save the cursor
regions.description: `$15`, `$14`, `$19`, `$18` are pushed (the far calls below use them).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the icon
regions.description: `JSR $820C`: the item's icon `$817B[X]` is uploaded to the CHR tile `$14` (below).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the effect
regions.description: `LDA $817B,X / JSR $C006` with `02 14 80`: a far call to bank 2 `$86BC` - **the pick-up routine: the item is really given** (a weapon level, a power-up, the Blue and Red Landers ...).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): restore the cursor
THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the number
regions.description: `LDA $817A,X / JSR $C051` (`$E1CD`): the threshold printed, followed by the four zeros (`$802E`).

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): the icon on screen
regions.description: `$18` += 5, `$17` := 0, `Y := $C0`; `LDA $14 / JSR $C054` (`$D865`): the 2 x 2 icon tiles starting at tile `$14` are put in the nametable beside the number.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): wait
regions.description: `LDY #$64 / JSR $C021` (`$FFD1`): 100 frames.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): next
regions.description: `$76` += 2; the tile `$14` += 4; the address `$19:$18` := ($18 AND `$C0`) + `$80`, OR 8: four text rows further down; until `$19` reaches `$23` - **at most five items on a screen**. RUN: with 30,000 points (total 3) the first call showed items 0-4 (`$76` = 10), the second items 5-9 (`$76` = 20), each call taking about 725 frames.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): end of the list
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `14 23 28 'GO TO THE NEXT SPACE'`: 20 characters at PPU `$2328`.

regions.name: THE REWARD SCREEN, `YOU GOT ITEM` (bank 3 slot `$8018` = `$80A0`; called by bank 7 `$ECE7` in a TGL game after each corridor): wait, fade out
regions.description: `LDY #$B4 / JSR $C021` (180 frames); `JMP $C0ED` (`$EDD1`: the fade out, which returns to the caller).

regions.name: Upload an item's icon (`$820C`)
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$1000` + 16 x `$14` (the pattern table 1 tile `$14`); `LDA $817B,X / JSR $C006` with `02 02 80`: a far call to bank 2 `$81B2` (icon A -> CHR). Then `RTS`.

regions.name: Return
regions.description: `RTS`.
